itemListElement.name: Schrödinger Hat
itemListElement.description: Software, events, talks and a podcast made together. I co-founded the community and contribute as a speaker. This is collective work. Open-source community.

itemListElement.name: Broskis
itemListElement.description: My personal publication on Substack. I write here. Publication.

itemListElement.name: Chromatique
itemListElement.description: One colour engine, several ways to use it: a Rust core with a CLI, language bindings and creative-tool interfaces. My work includes image analysis, image comparison and lightness-preserving palette selection. In development.

itemListElement.name: HolyCard AI
itemListElement.description: An editable devotional portrait-card studio with PNG and PDF exports. I developed the card studio, image-generation flow and forms. Digital-only beta.

itemListElement.name: CoproSync
itemListElement.description: A self-hosted workspace for condominium councils, projects and incidents. I developed the project workflow and co-owner portal. In development.

itemListElement.name: Alerting
itemListElement.description: A dashboard exploring economic and systemic-risk signals from public data. My development work includes monitoring continuity and retry handling. In development.

itemListElement.name: Hop
itemListElement.description: A shared team room for conversation, notes and ideas, with an optional agent. I’m developing the meeting-app prototype. Early prototype.

itemListElement.name: Social post
itemListElement.description: An ongoing personal project around social posts. Personal work in progress. In progress.

itemListElement.name: ImageGoNord
itemListElement.description: An open-source tool for converting images into a chosen palette. I co-authored ImageGoNord with Wabri, alongside the work of the Schrödinger Hat community. Public source.

itemListElement.name: Supermarket waiting times
itemListElement.description: A crowdsourced map of shop waiting times, built during lockdown. I built the service and evolved it from a Raspberry Pi to regional VPS infrastructure as demand grew. Archived project · 2020.

itemListElement.name: Learning to make comic books
itemListElement.description: Learning to tell stories through comic-book drawings. I’m learning and practising. In progress.

pages.text: Engineering with curiosity.I’m Miki Lombardi, a Senior Software Engineer at Adobe. My work spans software development, architecture and open source.Software. People. Shared ideas.I’ve worked in product and consultancy teams, including Aperion, Plansoft and Growens, before joining Adobe.I co-founded Schrödinger Hat, where software and community meet. Open-source projects, talks and shared experiments are part of how I learn and contribute beyond my day-to-day work.Beyond the keyboard.Cycling and photography are two of my other interests. I’m also learning to make comic books. The sketchbook will follow that process as I develop original drawings.
